text: dsh-i18n-zh-hant 是供 DSH 網頁介面使用的香港繁體中文語言包。它透過網頁端 locale 服務加入 zh-Hant 語言，並為多個核心及社群外掛命名空間註冊繁體中文翻譯字典；主機端入口則是空操作。未覆蓋的文字依語言定義回退至英文，原有簡體中文語言仍可保留。適合希望以香港繁體中文閱讀 DSH 網頁介面的人。使用時需要 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 或更新版本及 web profile，不需要額外 API key 或外部服務。

dsh-i18n-zh-hant adds Hong Kong Traditional Chinese to DSH web. Its browser entry registers zh-Hant and translation dictionaries; uncovered text falls back to English. The host entry is a no-op, and Simplified Chinese remains available. Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1+ with the web profile.
想把 DSH 網頁介面切換成香港繁體中文。
讓網頁版 DSH 的選單和外掛文字顯示繁體中文。
I want to use the DSH web interface in Traditional Chinese for Hong Kong.
dsh-i18n-zh-hant 的功能「加入繁體中文語言」：在 DSH 網頁端註冊 zh-Hant 語言，顯示名稱為「繁體中文」，並以英文作為回退語言。使用者可在介面語言選項中選擇它。
dsh-i18n-zh-hant 的功能「註冊繁體中文翻譯」：網頁端為涵蓋的 locale 命名空間註冊 zh-Hant 字典；未提供的鍵由語言回退鏈處理，不會取代各命名空間原有的簡體中文字典。

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · dsh-i18n-zh-hant：**繁體中文（香港）語言包** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) web GUI.

Adds **Traditional Chinese** to the language selector and carries `zh-Hant`
dictionaries for every core and community plugin locale namespace, so the whole
interface reads in Traditional Chinese instead of falling back to English.

The shipped Simplified Chinese (`zh`) locale is **not** modified — the two
coexist and you can switch between them at any time.

---

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · What it does：DSH's web GUI is localised through a per-namespace locale registry. Each client
plugin registers dictionaries for its own namespace, and the registry resolves a
lookup by walking the active language's fallback chain, then repeating it in the
shared `common` namespace, then showing the key itself.

This package is a **pure browser plugin** (its host half is intentionally a
no-op). On page load it:

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · What it does：1. Registers the language definition `zh-Hant` — label `繁體中文`, fallback `en` —
   through `ctx.locale.addLanguage`, which is what makes it appear in
   **Settings → General → Language**.
2. Registers one `zh-Hant` dictionary per covered namespace using the
   single-locale form `ctx.locale.register(ns, 'zh-Hant', dict)`.

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · What it does：Registration is **additive per locale**. Each namespace keeps the `zh` and `en`
dictionaries its owning package already registered, so Simplified Chinese is
untouched and remains fully selectable. Any namespace or key this pack does not
cover falls through to English, exactly as the source packages behave.

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · Coverage：| | |
|---|---|
| Namespaces | **56** |
| Keys | **2,860** |
| Scope | Core harness client packages + community plugin families |

Covered namespaces:

<details>
<summary>Click to expand the full list</summary>

```
approval                  betterSidebar             chat
command                   common                    conversation
cordis                    deliverables              describe-image
documentHtml              documentMarkdown          dsh-skill-explorer

</details>

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · Requirements：- DSH `>= 0.1.5-rc.1` with the web profile.
- Node.js 20+ only if you intend to run the maintainer tooling.

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · From a local checkout：```sh
git clone https://github.com/jimbb/dsh-i18n-zh-hant.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:./dsh-i18n-zh-hant
```

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · From a directory inside your profile：Copy or symlink this package into your profile's `node_modules`:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules
cp -r dsh-i18n-zh-hant ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/
```

Then add the row to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: web-ui-i18n-zh-hant
      name: 'dsh-i18n-zh-hant'
```

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · Activate：Restart the host — client package metadata is cached per loader entry until
restart, so a running `dsh web` will not serve a newly added bundle:

```sh
dsh web
```

Reload the page, then choose **繁體中文** in **Settings → General → Language**.

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · Verify it is working：With the host running:

```sh
npm run check     # bundle structure + consistency with dictionaries.json
npm run verify    # OpenCC script audit (requires: pip install opencc)
```

`npm run check` loads `lib/client.js` in a sandbox against a mock locale service
and asserts it registers exactly one language (`zh-Hant`, fallback `en`) plus one
dictionary per namespace, with contents identical to `lib/dictionaries.json`.

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · Verify it is working：`npm run verify` derives the Simplified-only character set from OpenCC's
Simplified→Traditional map and asserts no Simplified character survives in any
translated string, and that no value is empty.

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · Repository layout：```
lib/client.js          the browser bundle (generated — do not hand-edit)
lib/index.js           host half (intentional no-op)
lib/dictionaries.json  the translation data, namespace -> { key: text }
cordis.patch.yml       profile bundle patch that inserts the plugin row

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · Regenerating after a plugin update：When an upstream plugin adds or changes its Chinese strings, those keys fall back
to English until this pack is regenerated. The toolchain is four steps:

```sh

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · 1. Read every installed client plugin half and collect its zh/en dictionaries.：node dev/extract-dictionaries.mjs \
  ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules \
  <dsh-install>/node_modules \
  --out /tmp/upstream.json
section: 1. Read every installed client plugin half and collect its zh/en dictionaries.

text: dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · 2. Build translatable batches (namespace, key, Simplified source, English ref).：node dev/make-batches.mjs /tmp/upstream.json /tmp/translation
section: 2. Build translatable batches (namespace, key, Simplified source, English ref).

text:
dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · 4. Merge the translations and rebuild the bundle.：node dev/merge-translations.mjs /tmp/translation --out lib/dictionaries.json
node dev/build-bundle.mjs
node verify/check-bundle.mjs
```

`lib/client.js` is generated from `lib/dictionaries.json`; `npm run check` fails
if the two ever drift, so commit both together.
section: 4. Merge the translations and rebuild the bundle.

text:
dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · Translation notes：- **Variant:** Traditional Chinese with **Hong Kong** terminology — 檔案, 設定,
  網絡, 專案, 軟件, 列印, 儲存, 螢幕, 快取, 伺服器.
- **Placeholders** (`{count}`, `{total}`, `{error}`, …) are preserved verbatim and
  are checked at every stage.
- Strings are machine-generated and then validated for script correctness with
  [OpenCC](https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC). Wording can still be imperfect —
  corrections are welcome.

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · Known limitations：- `dsh-web-ui-market/online` is empty in the upstream Simplified **and** English
  dictionaries. The key is deliberately omitted here so the registry's fallback
  chain handles it exactly as it does for the Simplified locale.
- Six characters (台, 群, 峰, 划, 游, 床) are reported by the verifier as
  "ambiguous" because OpenCC's `s2t` map prefers an archaism or a Taiwan variant
  (臺, 羣, 峯, 劃, 遊, 牀). They are legitimate Traditional forms in Hong Kong
  usage (後台, 社群, 高峰, 划選, 上游, 起床) and are excluded from the hard check.
- Not every string in the GUI is localised by the source packages themselves;
  copy that bypasses the locale registry is out of reach for any language pack.

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · Contributing：Corrections to wording are the most valuable contribution. Edit
`lib/dictionaries.json`, run `npm run check && npm run verify`, then
`node dev/build-bundle.mjs` and include both files in your pull request.

dsh-i18n-zh-hant README · Uninstall：Delete the row from `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` and remove the package
directory, then restart `dsh web`.
